rules.statement: A co-owner of a land cannot maintain an action for declaration of title to a building standing on the common property.
rules.supporting_quote: The question that arises for decision on this appeal is whether a co-owner of a land can maintain an action for declaration of title to a building on the common property. The plaintiff claimed that he was entitled to 1/20 share of a land called Medaweraniyewatta situated in the village of Tittapattara and a tiled boutique built thereon by one James Appu his predecessor in title.
